source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including all written/read and other notes, not normalized reconstructions.
source.public_versification_note: Public Joshua 9–17 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 256 original source records are bound exactly once.

key_decisions.decision: Attaches the opening southward phrase to Avvim while noting an alternative attachment; preserves Mearah as a name.
Preserves emphatic divine future dispossession and the immediate allocation command as distinct actions.
Unfolds with him by the eastern half-tribe identified later in the chapter; notes that the Hebrew pronoun is compressed.
Keeps the explicit failure and continued residence rather than reconciling them with the preceding territory claim.
Preserves the offering-specific description of Levi’s inheritance, distinct from the LORD himself in verse 33.
Preserves the occupation label and explicit death rather than replacing diviner with prophet.
Renders Jordan and boundary as a boundary formula with the Hebrew wording noted; retains settlements and clan allocation.
Retains the divine inheritance formulation rather than substituting the offerings of verse 14.
